# 8. Infrastructure

## `infra/docker/Dockerfile.api`

```dockerfile
# API and worker share an image: same dependencies, different entry point.
FROM node:22-bookworm-slim AS base
ENV PNPM_HOME=/pnpm
ENV PATH="$PNPM_HOME:$PATH"
RUN corepack enable
WORKDIR /app

FROM base AS deps
COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml pnpm-workspace.yaml .npmrc ./
COPY apps/api/package.json apps/api/
COPY apps/worker/package.json apps/worker/
COPY apps/web/package.json apps/web/
COPY packages/adapters/package.json packages/adapters/
COPY packages/ai/package.json packages/ai/
COPY packages/config/package.json packages/config/
COPY packages/consent/package.json packages/consent/
COPY packages/contracts/package.json packages/contracts/
COPY packages/db/package.json packages/db/
COPY packages/pipeline/package.json packages/pipeline/
RUN pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts

FROM base AS runtime
ENV NODE_ENV=production
COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=deps /app/apps ./apps
COPY --from=deps /app/packages ./packages
COPY . .

# Never run as root, and never own the code you execute.
RUN useradd --system --create-home --uid 10001 everecho \
    && mkdir -p /app/var && chown -R everecho:everecho /app/var
USER everecho

EXPOSE 4000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --start-period=20s --retries=3 \
  CMD node -e "fetch('http://localhost:4000/healthz').then(r=>process.exit(r.ok?0:1)).catch(()=>process.exit(1))"

CMD ["pnpm", "--filter", "@everecho/api", "start"]
```

## `infra/docker/Dockerfile.web`

```dockerfile
FROM node:22-bookworm-slim AS base
ENV PNPM_HOME=/pnpm
ENV PATH="$PNPM_HOME:$PATH"
RUN corepack enable
WORKDIR /app

FROM base AS build
# Baked into the client bundle at build time, so it must be a URL the browser
# can reach — not an internal service name.
ARG NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:4000
ENV NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=$NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
COPY package.json pnpm-lock.yaml pnpm-workspace.yaml .npmrc ./
COPY apps ./apps
COPY packages ./packages
COPY tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.json ./
RUN pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
RUN pnpm --filter @everecho/web build

FROM base AS runtime
ENV NODE_ENV=production
COPY --from=build /app ./
RUN useradd --system --create-home --uid 10001 everecho && chown -R everecho:everecho /app/apps/web/.next
USER everecho
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["pnpm", "--filter", "@everecho/web", "start"]
```

## `infra/docker/docker-compose.yml`

```yaml
# Local development stack.
#
# UNVERIFIED in the build session that produced this file: no Docker daemon was
# reachable, so this compose file and the Dockerfiles beside it were written and
# reviewed but never executed. Everything they run — migrations, seed, API,
# worker, web — was exercised directly against a local PostgreSQL instead.
# Treat a first `docker compose up` as something to watch rather than trust.

name: everecho

services:
  postgres:
    # pgvector's image so the optional vector migration applies. Without it the
    # portable array path is used automatically; nothing breaks.
    image: pgvector/pgvector:pg16
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: everecho
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: everecho
      POSTGRES_DB: everecho
    ports: ['5432:5432']
    volumes:
      - postgres-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD-SHELL', 'pg_isready -U everecho -d everecho']
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 20

  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    command: ['redis-server', '--save', '', '--appendonly', 'no']
    ports: ['6379:6379']
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD', 'redis-cli', 'ping']
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 20

  minio:
    image: minio/minio:latest
    command: ['server', '/data', '--console-address', ':9001']
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: everecho
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: everecho-dev-secret
    ports: ['9000:9000', '9001:9001']
    volumes:
      - minio-data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ['CMD', 'mc', 'ready', 'local']
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 20

  # Creates the bucket once, then exits. Buckets stay private.
  minio-init:
    image: minio/mc:latest
    depends_on:
      minio: { condition: service_healthy }
    entrypoint: >
      /bin/sh -c "
      mc alias set local http://minio:9000 everecho everecho-dev-secret &&
      mc mb --ignore-existing local/everecho &&
      mc anonymous set none local/everecho
      "

  migrate:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: infra/docker/Dockerfile.api
    command: ['pnpm', '--filter', '@everecho/db', 'migrate']
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://everecho:everecho@postgres:5432/everecho
    depends_on:
      postgres: { condition: service_healthy }

  api:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: infra/docker/Dockerfile.api
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: development
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://everecho:everecho@postgres:5432/everecho
      CACHE_DRIVER: redis
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379
      STORAGE_DRIVER: s3
      S3_ENDPOINT: http://minio:9000
      S3_BUCKET: everecho
      S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID: everecho
      S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: everecho-dev-secret
      S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE: 'true'
      API_PUBLIC_URL: http://localhost:4000
      WEB_PUBLIC_URL: http://localhost:3000
      SESSION_SECRET: dev-only-session-secret-change-me-please
      STORAGE_SIGNING_SECRET: dev-only-storage-signing-secret-change-me
    ports: ['4000:4000']
    depends_on:
      migrate: { condition: service_completed_successfully }
      redis: { condition: service_healthy }
      minio-init: { condition: service_completed_successfully }
    healthcheck:
      test:
        [
          'CMD',
          'node',
          '-e',
          "fetch('http://localhost:4000/healthz').then(r=>process.exit(r.ok?0:1)).catch(()=>process.exit(1))",
        ]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  worker:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: infra/docker/Dockerfile.api
    command: ['pnpm', '--filter', '@everecho/worker', 'start']
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: development
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://everecho:everecho@postgres:5432/everecho
      CACHE_DRIVER: redis
      REDIS_URL: redis://redis:6379
      STORAGE_DRIVER: s3
      S3_ENDPOINT: http://minio:9000
      S3_BUCKET: everecho
      S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID: everecho
      S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: everecho-dev-secret
      S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE: 'true'
      SESSION_SECRET: dev-only-session-secret-change-me-please
      STORAGE_SIGNING_SECRET: dev-only-storage-signing-secret-change-me
    depends_on:
      migrate: { condition: service_completed_successfully }

  web:
    build:
      context: ../..
      dockerfile: infra/docker/Dockerfile.web
      args:
        NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: http://localhost:4000
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: http://localhost:4000
    ports: ['3000:3000']
    depends_on:
      api: { condition: service_healthy }

volumes:
  postgres-data:
  minio-data:
```
